gloss: betitle, title, give an epithet or cognomen
definition: [ כָּנָה ] verb Pi`el betitle, title, give an epithet or cognomen (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic כְּנָא , ; Arabic ) — Pi`el Imperfect 1 singular suffix בִשְׁמֶ֑ךָ אֲכַנְּךָוָאֶקְרָא לְךָ Isa 45:4 I have called thee by thy name, giving thee a title (of honour; compare for construction Dr § 163 ); 3 masculine singular וּבְשֵׁם יִשְׂרָאֵל יְכַנֶּה Isa 44:5 , and with the name Israel he titles (himself), is hardly possibly; absolute he betitles , or makes use of a title , is unlikely; read probably Pu`al , see below, in bad sense = give a flattering title: וְאֶלאָֿדָם לֹא אֲכַנֶּה Job 32:21 and unto man I do not give flattering titles (|| אַללֿנָא אֶשָּׂא פְנֵי אִישׁ ); absolute v Job 32:22 . Pu`al Imperfect יְכֻנֶּה Isa 44:5 he is betitled (see above; so ᵑ7 Bi Che Du ; || יקרא בשׁם יעקב , etc.)
